name: Ivan Smirnov
description: '''Ivan Nikolayevich Smirnov''' ({{langx|ru|Иван Николаевич Смирнов}}; 9 September 1955 in [[Moscow]], USSR – 15 November 2018) was regarded as one of the greatest guitar players in Russia. He was proficient in many different styles, such as [[jazz fusion|fusion]], [[world music|world]], [[Ethnic Russian music|Russian folk]], [[folk-jazz]], and [[new flamenco]]. Smirnov lived in Russia and played with musicians such as Mikhail Smirnov,  Sergey Klevensky, Dmitry Safonov, and [[Aleksei Kozlov (musician)|Aleksei Kozlov]].
